desc: Prism Shell: the support-fighter that turns shots around. Units: seconds, metres, hp.
name: Prism Shell

look.why: a crystal shell about 20% wider than you

shell_why: x1.1: a little more than base

baseline.why: run-speed bonus by weight class (a light hero keeps the most speed; merge cap +40%)

dash.why: a dodge leaves a refracting flash that slows what it touches

lmb.name: Crystal Shards
lmb.desc: Fire two piercing crystal shards. They pass through foes.

rmb.name: Prism
rmb.desc: Hold a prism up toward the cursor. Shots that hit it fly back at whoever fired them, hitting harder the longer you held.
rmb.why: ~145 degree frontal arc, 2.1m; reflected damage x1.0 rising to x1.5 at full (0.8s); up to 3s; you move at 60% while holding

e.name: Crystal Wall
e.desc: Raise a crystal wall at the cursor that reflects shots, and pulse healing to your squad around it.
e.why: 4.4m wall for 7s, heals 9 every second to allies within 3.4m

r.name: Shatter
r.desc: The shell cracks, then bursts outward, hurting foes and shielding your squad.
r.why: 0.55s of cracking with a 6.8m ground marker, then a burst: 40 dmg + stun to foes, a 70 hp shield for allies within 8m
